sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate is semantically faithful and deterministicValidation.valid is true. It targets the supplied ship owner, records all required coverage indicators and abandonment-environment input, uses the canonical DAY unit for both quantities, and enforces survivalSupportDuration >= maximumExpectedRescueTime without requiring derived-value equality.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Correct the time quantity unit constraint: qudt:DAY currently expands to http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/DAY, but the verified canonical recommended unit is http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/DAY. Bind the QUDT unit vocabulary namespace separately (for example, unit: <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/>) and use sh:hasValue unit:DAY for both duration quantities. Keep the comparison direction as survivalSupportDuration >= maximumExpectedRescueTime.

Candidate is semantically faithful and deterministicValidation.valid is true. It targets the supplied ship owner, records all required coverage indicators and abandonment-environment input, uses the canonical DAY unit for both quantities, and enforces survivalSupportDuration >= maximumExpectedRescueTime without requiring derived-value equality.
